description:
Workflow reports COMPLETED while IF children or skipped-branch continuation remain NOT_STARTED

## Environment

- Self-hosted Twenty 2.41.0, separate server and worker, PostgreSQL 16 and Redis 7.
- Image: `twentycrm/twenty@sha256:47bcefe4e497ceef232f149153a4a61379830f5c898b7da71a5b0e21fd5ea916`.
- Release source: `d1bb92d111f91529478da56aa677efbdba230c00`.
- Reproduced 19 September 2026 in an isolated clone using native manual workflows only.
- No provider credentials, external requests, custom actions or core modifications are required.

## Reproduction

Create three separate DRAFT workflows with a GLOBAL MANUAL trigger. Use native EMPTY steps, IF_ELSE with the constant Boolean condition `true IS true`, and CREATE_RECORD to create one local Task (`status: TODO`). Supply a fresh deterministic UUID and title for each receipt. Execute each draft once with the supported workflow-run act
